$comment: The stacks the prompts offer, in the order they are offered: where each loads LUZ, and the extensions npx @luz-ds/check reads as HTML (--ext). Read by scripts/docs-site/prompts.js.

stacks.name: Plain HTML
stacks.load: the `<link>` and `<script type="module">` tags in the `<head>` of every page

stacks.name: Astro
stacks.load: the `<head>` of the base layout, `src/layouts/*.astro`, or `import "@luz-ds/core/css"` in its frontmatter

stacks.name: React (Vite, Next.js)
stacks.load: `import "@luz-ds/tokens/css"`, then core and catalog, in the entry or the root layout; `class` is `className`

stacks.name: Vue (Vite, Nuxt)
stacks.load: the imports of `main.js`, or `css` in `nuxt.config`, in the load order

stacks.name: Other
stacks.load: wherever the stack puts global stylesheets, in the load order
